status: accepted; the node binding selects the proof phase and the gateway supplies it on correlated dispatch
dispatch_rule: Only the accepted node binding selects proof_phase. The checked-in workflow default stays 'none' so the gateway can qualify evidence; a tool argument must never select it, and a rerun reuses GitHub's recorded inputs and is refused.

maintainer_owned: the identity-proof job's id-token: write permission
evidence_transport.private_phase_evidence: atlassian-identity-proof-{run_id}-{run_attempt} in the private CI evidence bucket, 14-day retention, independently read back in-job under the preserved scoped runner identity
evidence_transport.published_summary: deployment-evidence/v1/{repository_id}/{run_id}/{run_attempt}/repository-artifact/identity-proof.json: a GitHub-OIDC-signed descriptor, audience-bound to its exact bytes, over a write-once SSE-AES256 versioned archive of atlassian-stage-summary.json
evidence_transport.publication_order: the summary is staged and signed only after the private readback succeeds; a failed or missing readback publishes nothing
evidence_transport.native_reader: EvidenceStore.read_archive authenticates the signed descriptor, then reads that exact object version
evidence_transport.unchanged: the logical artifact name atlassian-stage-{run_id}-{run_attempt}, its atlassian-stage-summary.json path and all evaluator-amendment-8446.json predicates; only the transport moved off GitHub Actions artifact storage, whose quota failed the previous attempt's final upload

source_binding.required_equalities: SOURCE_REVISION == GATEWAY_REVISION; GITHUB_SHA == github.workflow_sha == DEFINITION_REVISION == checked-out HEAD; the source must be an ancestor of that definition
source_binding.advancement: only a native checked repair merge to main advances these pins; a worker must not edit a pin, supply a reserved dispatch input or change workflow authority

verifier_repair.state: installed and verified; a verifier repair only, not a new provider capability
verifier_repair.effect: binds the accepted proof_phase to the issued grant, the workflow observer and the recorded dispatch context, so a correlated proof run is no longer dropped from runtime verification when the selector is omitted during input comparison
verifier_repair.comparator: unchanged and strict: dispatch inputs must equal the accepted binding exactly, reserved selectors stay gateway-supplied, a mismatch fails closed with no receipt

prior_attempt.observed: 112 controlled tests, private readback and signed S3 publication all passed; every deployment check passed
prior_attempt.runtime_result: no receipt: native runtime verification rejected the run because the accepted proof_phase was omitted during input comparison
prior_attempt.handling: preserved as observed; this green Actions run is not a runtime receipt and must not be cited as one

verification.runtime: from the native gateway-backend deployment receipt, never from a claim in the summary
verification.green_run_insufficient: a successful job graph only proves the workflow ran; runtime_verified:gateway-backend requires the native receipt the observer correlates to the issued grant by repository, component, source revision, definition revision, run id, run attempt and the accepted proof_phase
verification.advancement_precondition: the installed maintenance counts only once a native checked repair merge advances the selected source pins
verification.cleanup: generated_only: the generated owned-resource case is verified; remote grant revocation is not
